The product

One system. Seven important jobs.

Everything a modern restaurant needs to run its website, its bookings and its table service — built, deployed and supported by Webescapade.

01 / EDIT

Edit whenever you want

Change menus, prices, photos, opening hours, branding and page content whenever your restaurant needs it — from the same toolbar you see here.

  • ✓ Tap any text or photo to change it
  • ✓ Themes, logo, hero video and animated hero

yourrestaurant.com
02 / BOOKINGS

Take smarter direct bookings

Guests choose their preferred sitting and a precise arrival time while the system checks your configured availability. A sitting might be 6:00 PM or 8:00 PM — the guest then picks an exact available arrival time within it.

  • ✓ Sittings with precise arrival times
  • ✓ Checks configured availability and capacity
  • ✓ Reservations arrive directly to the restaurant

Checks configured availability and helps the restaurant control capacity and reduce overbooking.

yourrestaurant.com
03 / PROTECTION

Protect large-party reservations

For bookings of eight or more, request a secure card guarantee to help protect against late cancellations and no-shows.

  • ✓ Triggered for parties of eight or more
  • ✓ Guest confirms a secure Stripe card guarantee
  • ✓ Helps reduce large-party no-shows

Card details are handled by Stripe and are not stored by Webescapade.

🛡️

Secure card guarantee

Large parties confirm with a card guarantee through Stripe. Cards are handled securely by Stripe — never stored by Webescapade or the restaurant website.

05 / TABLE ORDERING

Let customers order directly from the table

Each table receives its own QR code. Guests confirm their table, browse the menu, select items and send their order whenever they are ready.

  • ✓ No application download
  • ✓ Unique QR code for every table
  • ✓ Mobile-friendly menu
  • ✓ Search and dietary filters
  • ✓ Guests can place additional orders during the meal
  • ✓ No personal information or payment details required

The order is sent to the restaurant only — no payment is taken through the guest’s phone. The bill is settled at the counter or table.

Confirm the table · browse the menu · customise · send

06 / RESTAURANT OPERATIONS

One order. The right department.

Orders are organised by table and sent to the appropriate kitchen, bar or service display, including quantities, modifiers and customer notes.

  • ✓ Kitchen and bar order displays
  • ✓ Clear table identification
  • ✓ Dish modifiers and preparation choices
  • ✓ Allergy and special-request notes
  • ✓ Open-table totals
  • ✓ Fewer opportunities for order re-entry errors

A standalone ordering and workflow system — it runs alongside your existing POS rather than replacing it.

Kitchen · bar · counter, from the same order

07 / REPORTING

Finish the shift with organised records

Review open and settled tables, record cash or card settlement, create end-of-shift readings and export the information for analysis and bookkeeping.

  • ✓ Current-shift totals

  • ✓ Cash and card records

From QR code to kitchen

Ordering should be simple for the guest and clear for the restaurant.

Five steps, shown with the real Restaurant Deluxe table-ordering screens.

Swipe to move through the steps →

STEP 1

Scan the table QR

Every table has its own QR code. The customer confirms the table number before viewing the menu.

STEP 2

Browse the live menu

Guests browse food and drinks, search the menu and filter suitable dietary options.

STEP 3

Customise the order

Guests choose quantities, dish options and modifiers, and can add preparation or allergy notes.

Allergy notes are passed to the restaurant, but normal staff verification and food-safety procedures still apply.

STEP 4

Send the order

The completed order is sent with its table number to the relevant preparation area.

STEP 5

Manage and settle the table

Staff monitor open tables, record settlement at the counter or table, close the shift and export the records.

Questions

Good to know.

Can I update the website myself?+
Yes. You can change menus, prices, photos, opening hours, text, branding and page sections without waiting for a developer.
How does the booking system manage availability?+
It checks the capacity and sitting rules configured by the restaurant and helps control the number of online reservations accepted.
What happens with bookings of eight or more?+
The guest can be asked to provide a secure Stripe card guarantee. This helps protect the restaurant against large-party no-shows and late cancellations.
Does Webescapade store card details?+
No. Card information is securely handled by Stripe and is not stored by Webescapade or the restaurant website.
Is setup and support included?+
Yes. Webescapade helps configure the website, booking rules and integrations and provides ongoing support.
Can I change or cancel my plan?+
Speak with Webescapade about the most suitable plan and current terms.
Does this replace our POS?+
No. Restaurant Deluxe Table Ordering is designed as a standalone ordering and workflow system that can operate alongside your existing POS. Customers settle their bill at the counter or table.
Do customers pay through their phone?+
No. The system sends the order to the restaurant, but does not collect the customer’s payment or card details. Payment is completed at the counter or table.
Can we change our menu and prices ourselves?+
Yes. You can update menu sections, dishes, descriptions, photographs, prices, modifiers and availability through the management system.
Can we mark a dish as sold out?+
Yes. A dish can be temporarily marked as sold out or hidden without deleting it.
How does the restaurant know which table ordered?+
Every table uses a unique QR code. The table is confirmed before the menu opens, and that table number stays connected to the order.
Can orders be separated between kitchen and bar?+
Yes. Menu areas and items can be assigned to the appropriate restaurant department.
Can we export our records?+
Yes. Shift and settlement information can be exported in an Excel-compatible format for further analysis and bookkeeping.
What if a customer prefers normal table service?+
The QR system is an additional ordering choice. The restaurant can continue offering its normal staff service.
